description: A Roman road-side settlement dated between the 2nd and 4th CE. One of the features identified was a circular chalk floor overlaying an earlier filled in pit. The chalk floor contained what has been recognised as priestly regalia, leading to the feature to be identified as a shrine. There was another chalk floored feature nearby.
